title: Serum Proteome Analysis of IgA Nephropathy
projectDescription: Proteome comparison between IgAN patients who progressed (PR) and those who remained stable (non-progressors, NP) before clinical divergence.
sampleProcessingProtocol: We analyzed serum samples from adult patients (age >18) with biopsy-confirmed IgAN (n = 40, M = 36).  Clinical data and serum samples were collected at the baseline, prior to any sign of disease progression, and patients were followed for up to 5-6 years. Patients were categorized as progressor (PR) or non-progressor (NP), based on estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) slope calculated from the eGFR change divided by its years of follow-up. GFR was calculated by CKD-EPI formula ("A New Equation to Estimate Glomerular Filtration Rate," 2009). The study was approved by The Regional Ethics Committee Western Norway. 40 non-IgA samples were also included.
dataProcessingProtocol: Serum samples underwent protein depletion, SP3 digestion, TMT labeling and LC-MS/MS analysis. Files were processed using Proteome Discover and Perseus. Contaminants and proteins with less than one unique peptide were excluded. Data were normalized using Limma. Differentially expressed proteins were identified using Welch’s t-test. Enrichment analysis (GO, KEGG) was performed with ShinyGO and Cytoscape. Random Forest machine learning was applied for classification modeling.
